noncomputable def EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence : Type :=
  Sigma fun z : EntireXiPullbackNonzeroZero =>
    Fin (analyticOrderNatAt EntireXiPullback z.1)

declarations.name: entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence_fiber_natCard
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence_fiber_natCard
    (z : EntireXiPullbackNonzeroZero) :
    Nat.card {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence // i.1 = z} =
      analyticOrderNatAt EntireXiPullback z.1

declarations.name: HadamardNegationPairingData
declarations.source_excerpt:
structure HadamardNegationPairingData
    {ι : Type u} (zeroLoc : ι → ℂ) where
  half : Type u
  pairEquiv : half × Bool ≃ ι
  loc_true : ∀ j, zeroLoc (pairEquiv (j, true)) =
    -zeroLoc (pairEquiv (j, false))

declarations.name: HadamardNegationPairingData.ofInvolution
declarations.source_excerpt:
noncomputable def HadamardNegationPairingData.ofInvolution
    {ι : Type*} (zeroLoc : ι → ℂ)
    (e : ι ≃ ι) (hinv : Function.Involutive e) (hfree : ∀ i, e i ≠ i)
    (hloc : ∀ i, zeroLoc (e i) = -zeroLoc i) :
    HadamardNegationPairingData zeroLoc := by
  classical
  letI : LinearOrder ι := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  exact
    { half := involutionHalf e
      pairEquiv := involutionPairEquiv e hinv hfree
      loc_true := by
        intro j
        simpa [involutionPairEquiv] using hloc j.1 }

declarations.name: actualZeroScale_inv_summable
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem actualZeroScale_inv_summable :
    Summable (fun i : ActualPairIndex => (actualZeroScale i)⁻¹)

declarations.name: actualPairZero_sq_of_RH
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem actualPairZero_sq_of_RH (hRH : RiemannHypothesis) (i : ActualPairIndex) :
    (actualPairZero i) ^ 2 = (actualZeroScale i : ℂ)

declarations.name: actual_theta_paired_factorization
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem actual_theta_paired_factorization (hRH : RiemannHypothesis) :
    ∃ C : ℂ, C ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ z : ℂ,
      AWPIRH.theta z = C * (-Complex.I * Complex.sqrt z) ^
        entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity *
        ∏' i : ActualPairIndex, (1 + z / (actualZeroScale i : ℂ))

declarations.name: affineProduct_hasProdLocallyUniformlyOn_origin
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem affineProduct_hasProdLocallyUniformlyOn_origin
    {ι : Type*} {b : ι → ℂ} (hb : Summable (fun i => ‖b i‖)) :
    HasProdLocallyUniformlyOn (fun i (z : ℂ) => 1 + z * b i)
      (fun z => ∏' i, (1 + z * b i)) (ball 0 1)

declarations.name: logDeriv_affineProduct_zero
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem logDeriv_affineProduct_zero
    {ι : Type*} {b : ι → ℂ} (hb : Summable (fun i => ‖b i‖)) :
    logDeriv (fun z : ℂ => ∏' i, (1 + z * b i)) 0 = ∑' i, b i

declarations.name: actual_theta_normalized_complex_factorization
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem actual_theta_normalized_complex_factorization (z : ℂ) :
    AWPIRH.theta z = AWPIRH.theta 0 *
      ∏' i : ActualPairIndex, (1 + z / actualComplexScale i)

declarations.name: actual_theta_origin_logDeriv_eq_tsum
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem actual_theta_origin_logDeriv_eq_tsum :
    deriv AWPIRH.theta 0 / AWPIRH.theta 0 =
      ∑' i : ActualPairIndex, (actualComplexScale i)⁻¹

declarations.name: entireXiPullback_logDerivative_canonicalExpansion_unconditional
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem entireXiPullback_logDerivative_canonicalExpansion_unconditional
    (z : ℂ) (hz0 : z ≠ 0)
    (hzloc : ∀ i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence,
      z ≠ entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i) :
    logDerivativeResponse EntireXiPullback z =
      (entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity : ℂ) / z +
        hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
          entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc z
